atomicity.reason: One obligation: inhibit traction while a passenger door is open.

parent_fit.reason: Directly realises 'the bus does not move off while I board or leave through an open door'.

unambiguity.reason: 'open' is not defined (fully closed and locked vs. not fully closed), an edge case that matters for an interlock.
unambiguity.suggestion: Define door state as 'not detected closed and locked'.

variant_consistency.reason: Gated by spelled-out bus condition (var.vehicle.type == 'bus'), same as its parent.

verifiability.reason: Concrete test: open any passenger door and confirm no traction torque is delivered.
